articles.title: Section 21 “pushed thousands into homelessness” says government
articles.summary: The government claims the former Section 21 possession powers resting with landlords “pushed thousands into homelessness”. The claim comes in a statement about the repeal of the Vagrancy Act today. This ends nearly two centuries of legislation that has criminalised rough sleeping and begging. Labour says the Act pushed vulnerable people away from support, increased […]
articles.ai_summary:
- The government attributes the former Section 21 possession powers to driving thousands into homelessness, emphasizing the need for reform in housing laws.  
- The repeal of the Vagrancy Act ends nearly 200 years of criminalizing rough sleeping and begging, a move backed by Labour, which argues the Act hindered support for vulnerable individuals.
